name: Starlink Group 15-16
slot_a_text: B1082 is flying for the 26th time. It has landed 25 times out of 26. Recovery is 574 km downrange, on the drone ship Of Course I Still Love You.
slot_b_text: B1082 has flown 25 times in more than 2 years. Mostly Starlink: 21 of them, 1 USSF, 1 OneWeb, and 2 others. Its quickest turnaround was 25 days.
description: A batch of 27 satellites for the Starlink mega-constellation - SpaceX's project for space-based Internet communication system.
program_description: Starlink is a satellite internet constellation operated by American aerospace company SpaceX
rocket_fact: Astronauts on the International Space Station witness 16 sunrises and sunsets every single day.
